items.title: Retire the daily wildcard from your feeds
items.detail: The wildcard is the day's best gate-scored story your interests missed, added on top of the feed slots. In November you rated 18 of them: 1 wanted in the feed, 5 for the show only, 12 bad. Four of the bad were US politics (Trump and science funding, Rubio and Nvidia, NIH trials, today's RFK Jr. and the USPSTF) and three were bad news (Kuehne's death, Mexico's femicide squad, Deutsche Bank and Russian oligarchs). The gate passed all seven, so the slot is spending its day on the gate's misses.
items.fix: Drop pass 3 (the wildcard) from the reader feeds and the review batch's wildcard stratum. The alternative, if you want to keep a surprise slot: screen it with the podcast's bad-news filter and leave US-politics outlets out of it. No API cost either way.

items.title: US health-policy fights keep getting past your US-politics line
items.detail: Second RFK Jr. / HHS story through the gate in 12 days: NYT Well on RFK Jr. and the USPSTF (today, the wildcard, shipped in the wellness feed and sitting in the podcast pool at a Sunday charter score of 57), after Forbes on HHS and unapproved peptides (Nov 8, shipped and in the pool). Science-Based Medicine on NIH-funded trials (Nov 10) is the same family. The gate reads them as health stories, not US politics.
items.fix: One line in standing_preferences.txt naming US federal health and science policy fights (HHS, NIH, CDC, FDA, USPSTF, RFK Jr.) as US politics. That file is yours: approving this is the ask, and I would open it as a PR for you to merge. Sunday's standing-preferences job may also propose it from these notes.

items.title: Add a YouTube status check to the daily episode review
items.detail: From another session (Nov 18), no open PR; this branch's earlier PR #564 merged Nov 16. Its commit message says the upload ledger recorded twelve videos as done that YouTube then abandoned as too long. The review would read the video ID from the run log, ask YouTube for its processing status, show it in the numbers table and raise a youtube-failed signal. 6 files, +225 lines, and the review job gets the YT_* secrets for the read.
items.fix: Approve and I open a PR from it, run the suite and merge on green. It hands the review job YouTube credentials, so it is your call.

items.title: YouTube channel banner with the title inside the mobile safe area
items.detail: From another session (Nov 18), no PR. Two commits that add assets/youtube-banner.png (2.2 MB) and key out its title plate. Nothing in the pipeline reads it; it is for uploading to the channel by hand.
items.fix: Approve to merge the image into the repo; decline to delete the branch. Either way the banner itself is uploaded in YouTube Studio.
